radius.$description: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED — no dedicated Figma foundation page for border-radius exists, but 'sm' and 'md' are now confirmed directly via live Figma design context across many components. lg/xl/2xl are still inferred from arbitrary rounded-[Npx] values in the 5 codebases. ⚠️ CRITICAL, from the 2026-07-23 real-usage audit: none of the 5 apps' Tailwind configs actually define a custom borderRadius at all — this entire scale exists only in Figma/this tokens repo today. Every app relies on Tailwind's stock radius values (which don't match this scale at sm/md/lg) plus hand-rolled arbitrary rounded-[Npx] values to compensate. Wiring this scale into each app's Tailwind config is a Phase 3 prerequisite, not just documentation.

sm.$description: Confirmed across Button (all variants/sizes), Input Field/Box, Modal, Accordion (implicit, no radius), Tab/Pill, Table Leading Cell's icon container, and — confirmed 2026-07-25 via real code — the shared Button component's remove/add controls inside List Field row-repeaters (explicit `border-radius: 6px` in recruitment-portal's Button.vue; dashboard-main's equivalent drifts to Tailwind's stock 4px instead, a real, unresolved inconsistency). CORRECTED 2026-07-25: 'File Upload Prompt' and 'Side Nav Item' were removed from this list — a real-code audit found File Upload actually uses 20px (`3xl`, see its entry) and Side Nav's active item uses 8px (`md`) in every real implementation, not 6px. Both were Figma-only claims that didn't survive contact with real code.

md.$description: Confirmed via Stat and Tooltip — both independently use exactly 8px. Also confirmed 2026-07-25 via real code: Side Navigation's active item (`rounded-lg`), and the outer track of the one real segmented-control pattern found (`ListViewToggle.vue` in recruitment-portal, `rounded-lg p-1`) — the literal `ButtonGroup.vue` component that this token was originally attributed to turned out to be a bare, unstyled layout wrapper with no radius of its own; see this file's Components section for the full story.

lg.$description: The single most-evidenced arbitrary value in real code: 100+ combined rounded-[10px]/rounded-[0.625rem] instances across 4 of the 5 apps (dashboard alone has 97+), because none of them have this value configured as a named class.

xl.$description: A borderline, weaker-evidence gap sits just above this value: 14px appears in 3 of 5 apps (client-web's single most-common arbitrary radius value, 14 uses; also present at lower volume in career-web and dashboard). RESOLVED (2026-07-25): not a new 7th step — 14px snaps to 2xl(16px) rather than xl(12px). Numerically it's equidistant (2px either way), but client-web (its strongest source) also independently validated 3xl(20px) as a real, needed step, suggesting that app trends toward more generous rounding overall — 16px fits that pattern better than rounding down to 12px would.

2xl.$description: Also the resolved snap target for the real-but-unformalized 14px gap seen in 3 of 5 apps — see xl's entry for reasoning.

3xl.$description: Added from the 2026-07-23 real-usage audit, not from Figma. 20px recurs as a hand-rolled arbitrary rounded-[20px]/rounded-[1.25rem] value across 4 of the 5 apps (80+ combined instances) with no existing token covering it — strong enough, consistent enough evidence to formalize as a real scale step. STRENGTHENED 2026-07-25: File Upload's real component (`FormUploadBox.vue`, present in 4 of 5 apps) uses an explicit `border-radius: 20px` in every real copy, overriding Tailwind's own `rounded-lg` class also present in the markup — a fifth, direct confirmation, and a correction of this file's earlier claim that File Upload confirmed `sm` (6px) instead.

full.$description: Confirmed via Avatar (circular, literal Figma value 100px which renders identically to 9999px at any realistic size), Badge (24px on a 32px-tall pill — over-rounded to guarantee a full pill regardless of height), and Form Control Switch — confirmed 2026-07-25 via real code: the shared `FormToggle.vue` uses `rounded-full` on both its track and thumb, present in 4 of 5 apps.
